summary: Accessible loading feedback and phase2 private PDF document ingestion, real extraction and review
independenceRationale: New private file ingestion, parsing and tenant-bound corrections require independent architecture/security and QA review.
acceptance: Accessible scoped loaders distinguish initial, background and mutation waits without false progress or hiding readable rows.
Verified current members can list/download only organization-owned PDF documents; owner/admin/analyst can upload/correct; viewer cannot mutate.
Private upload validates size/type/checksum; errors and unsupported scanned documents remain explicit without fabricated extraction.
Actual PDF bytes yield versioned extraction with page/snippet evidence and uncertain/missing data; human corrections preserve original provenance.
Synthetic pickup62 USD carrier/transport/tariff/operational sources have explicit demo markings and isolated expected results; no financial verdict in phase2.
Any business jobs use durable PostgreSQL intent, idempotency and bounded retries with recovery evidence.
User guide and status describe actual implemented scope and reproducible checks.
semanticRouting: All16 roles apply: new document product scope, logistics fixtures, UX/loaders, tenant-bound storage/schema/extraction/jobs, platform dependencies and real acceptance tests. Root product/domain acceptance precedes business implementation; independent architecture and design precede dependent work.
